The '''XV-09 chemical restraint harness''', also known as the '''Pacifier''' was a device sold by [[Xenovet]] for 1,200 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] that used chemicals to pacify wild animals. Many individuals who made their livings working with animals considered the Pacifier to be a "cheap shortcut."<ref name="Stay on Target" />
